patches.value: Space V n is Fin n → ℝ, carrying its finite-product topology and product Lebesgue volume. Its Mathlib sup norm is used only as an auxiliary compatible finite-dimensional norm; source Euclidean coordinate topology, compactness and derivatives are unchanged, and source Euclidean norm expressions on spatial vectors are not replaced by this sup norm. Target W m is EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)=PiLp 2 with the Euclidean L² norm and inner product sum of coordinate products. Fin n enumerates source coordinates 1,...,n by j.val+1. u is total on V×ℝ; all assumptions and conclusions concern t>0, and restriction/extension on this open domain leaves derivatives unchanged. ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ means smooth to every finite order; scoped ∞ is (⊤:ℕ∞) coerced to WithTop ℕ∞, whereas the top of WithTop ℕ∞ is analytic order ω. All derivatives are total deriv/fderiv, zero if absent; smoothness at positive times justifies their ordinary meaning. Iterated Fréchet derivative vanishing in N002 is equivalent to all positive-order coordinate partials vanishing by evaluating the multilinear map on the finite spatial/time coordinate basis. fields enumerates exactly e,et,A,Bj,Tj,gj,dgj; membership carries no theorem. energy is a total Bochner integral expression; T003 supplies the guard that it is the finite Lebesgue energy on positive times. No M ports or background-note premise ports are needed. H003 is retained though unused in the source route.
